description: This file defines the Product class within the Admin Controller Event namespace of Opencart, extending the core Controller. It contains methods to handle after-events for adding, editing, and deleting products, and schedules related tasks by adding entries to a task model.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Controller class handling product-related events for adding, editing, and deleting products, and scheduling associated tasks.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Handles post-processing after a product is added, scheduling a task to generate product info.

methods.name: editProduct
methods.description: Handles post-processing after a product is edited, scheduling a task to update product info.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Handles post-processing after a product is deleted, scheduling a task to delete product info.
